sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate faithfully targets ships, follows the supplied ship-to-structural-member-to-cutout path, places ship-owned instability, necessity, and stiffening evidence properties on the ship, and correctly enforces the conditional stiffening-evidence boundary.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Replace the sh:or accidental-pass logic: do not permit compliance merely because the ship has no hasStructuralMember/hasCutout sequence. Traverse ship hasStructuralMember to the structuralMember and enforce the relevant member/cutout condition using hasCutout and memberInWayOfCutout, while requiring memberInstability false on its authoritative ship owner. Also encode the mandatory conditional: when a relevant structural member has stiffeningNecessary true, require the supplied structuralStiffening evidence on its declared ship owner. Do not place hasCutout directly after hasStructuralMember as a maxCount-zero prohibition; it bans cutouts rather than checking that their loads do not cause instability, and it omits the stiffening obligation.

Remove the unconditional sh:minCount 1 requirement for a cutout/member: the rule is conditional and does not require that a ship have any cut-out or affected member. Do not require ship-level memberInstability for every ship; enforce the no-instability result only for the applicable member-in-way-of-cutout case using the declared ownership model. Move stiffeningNecessary from the structural-member SPARQL pattern to its authoritative required owner ship, and retain the conditional requirement that ship-level structuralStiffening evidence is present when that ship-level selector is true. Preserve the member-to-cutout relationship and ensure the in-way selector is required and true for each relevant linked member without imposing an existence obligation when no such member exists.

Candidate faithfully targets ships, follows the supplied ship-to-structural-member-to-cutout path, places ship-owned instability, necessity, and stiffening evidence properties on the ship, and correctly enforces the conditional stiffening-evidence boundary.
